publication_window.rule: Publish no more than two articles per Beijing calendar day, only after all content, translation, cover, source, build, static SEO, internal-link and future-publication checks pass. Do not backfill missed dates.

notes: This is a topic queue, not evidence that any article has been written, reviewed, scheduled in the CMS, or published.
Topics are procurement-intent hypotheses, not verified search-volume or ranking claims.
Avoid unsupported continent-wide demand statistics and country-specific legal or certification claims. Verify any such claim against current primary sources during drafting.
Every article must have a distinct buyer problem and at least three contextual internal links plus a relevant inquiry path.
As of 2026-10-29, slots 3-20 have six-language draft files and unique cover assets locally; they remain unpublished until individual QA/build and scheduled dates. Draft creation is not publication.

articles.title: Kenya Security Door Project RFQ: A Buyer’s Checklist for Drawings, Openings and Hardware
articles.intent: Kenya project buyer preparing a comparable supplier quotation
articles.angle: Define opening schedule, handing, wall build-up, hardware, finish, quantity breaks and submittal evidence; distinguish a usable RFQ from a broad price request.

articles.title: Planning a Door Range for Nigerian Distributors: Segments, Samples and Reorder Checks
articles.intent: Nigeria distributor planning a door assortment
articles.angle: Build a range matrix by customer segment, opening type, finish, hardware and replenishment; use sample feedback and sell-through evidence rather than one assumed national profile.

articles.title: Door Finish Selection for Coastal Projects in Ghana: A Specification and Sample Checklist
articles.intent: Ghana coastal project team choosing exterior door finishes
articles.angle: Assess exposure, substrate, coating system, edge details, maintenance plan and sample approval; avoid implying a finish is corrosion-proof without test evidence.

articles.title: South Africa Multi-Residential Door Procurement: From Door Schedule to Evidence Review
articles.intent: South African developer or contractor procuring door sets for multi-residential buildings
articles.angle: Coordinate door marks, performance requirements, hardware, accessibility, fire strategy and project-specific approvals; direct readers to verify applicable local requirements with the responsible professional.

articles.title: Egypt Commercial Door Schedule: What to Confirm Before Requesting a Project Quote
articles.intent: Egyptian commercial project buyer preparing a door package
articles.angle: Map door locations to use, dimensions, handing, finish, lock/access needs, documentation and delivery phases; separate confirmed specification from open design decisions.

articles.title: Ethiopia Contractor Guide: Preparing a Security Door Drawing and Submittal Package
articles.intent: Ethiopian contractor submitting door details for project review
articles.angle: List elevations, schedules, opening data, wall interface, hardware set, finish samples and evidence register needed to reduce clarification cycles.

articles.title: Tanzania Hotel Door Sets: Coordinating Guestroom, Service and Common-Area Requirements
articles.intent: Tanzania hotel owner or consultant coordinating door-set packages
articles.angle: Separate guestroom, service, plant and public-area schedules; coordinate privacy, access, acoustic and fire requirements only where the project brief calls for them.

articles.title: A Practical After-Sales and Spare-Parts Plan for Door Distributors in Uganda
articles.intent: Uganda distributor planning service and spare-parts support
articles.angle: Create a model/part cross-reference, warranty escalation path, installer training plan, reorder thresholds and customer handover pack without promising unsupported local service coverage.

articles.title: Rwanda Hospitality Projects: A Door and Access-Control Brief for Procurement Teams
articles.intent: Rwanda hotel or serviced-apartment project team coordinating access
articles.angle: Translate room types and operational workflows into a door/lock matrix, guest/staff permission levels, emergency procedures and commissioning checks; no blanket smart-lock compatibility claims.

articles.title: Launching a Door Product Range in Morocco: Distributor Localization Checklist
articles.intent: Morocco distributor preparing localized product and sales materials
articles.angle: Plan French/Arabic terminology review, sample selection, installation documentation, product naming and channel training; validate translations with local technical reviewers.

articles.title: Côte d’Ivoire Door Projects: A French-Language Technical Submittal Checklist
articles.intent: Côte d’Ivoire consultant or contractor assembling a French project submittal
articles.angle: Organize bilingual product schedules, drawings, approved samples, hardware, test evidence and revision control; identify which project authority must confirm applicable requirements.

articles.title: Preparing a Door Quotation for Apartment Projects in Senegal
articles.intent: Senegal developer or contractor seeking comparable apartment door quotations
articles.angle: Group repeated opening types, record finish and hardware options, define mock-up approval and phase quantities, and issue a clear inclusions/exclusions schedule.

articles.title: Mozambique Coastal Projects: Door Submittals, Finish Review and Maintenance Planning
articles.intent: Mozambique project buyer evaluating doors for coastal exposure
articles.angle: Turn exposure assumptions into documented finish selection, sample review, installation details and maintenance instructions; keep performance claims tied to supplier evidence.

articles.title: Zambia Project Handover: Inspecting Door Installation, Hardware and Records
articles.intent: Zambia contractor or owner representative preparing door handover
articles.angle: Provide an observable inspection sequence for clearances, operation, hardware, labels, finish, defects and close-out records; distinguish visual checks from certified testing.

articles.title: Angola Project Door RFQs: Turning a Design Brief into a Comparable Supplier Quote
articles.intent: Angola project procurement team creating an RFQ from design documents
articles.angle: Use a scope matrix for door marks, quantities, dimensions, wall interfaces, finishes, hardware, approvals, packing and delivery milestones; flag missing data instead of guessing.

articles.title: Door Shipment Receiving Checklist for West African Distributors and Project Teams
articles.intent: West African importer or distributor planning shipment receipt and damage control
articles.angle: Specify packaging labels, pallet/container plan, photo records, count reconciliation, moisture protection and claims workflow; do not invent customs rules or transit times.

articles.title: East Africa Multi-Building Projects: A Door Schedule Template for Phased Procurement
articles.intent: Regional project team purchasing doors across multiple buildings or phases
articles.angle: Show how to normalize door marks, variants, quantities, finish, hardware, approval status and delivery phase without losing building-level traceability.

articles.title: Smart Lock Site Survey for African Projects: Connectivity, Power and Support Questions
articles.intent: Project buyer checking smart-lock fit before specifying bulk quantities
articles.angle: Survey door preparation, network architecture, power/backup, credential workflow, privacy, installation and support; make no claims about local network quality or product compatibility without verification.

articles.title: Door Mock-Ups and Sample Approval: A Project Workflow for African Buyers
articles.intent: Architect or procurement team planning product samples and mock-up approvals
articles.angle: Define representative opening selection, finish/colour approval, hardware coordination, sign-off roles, revision capture and release-to-production checkpoints.

articles.title: Door Project Documentation Matrix: What African Importers Should Request and Retain
articles.intent: Importer or project buyer organizing supplier documents and close-out records
articles.angle: Create a document register for drawings, specifications, test reports, installation instructions, warranties, packing records and revisions; explain matching each document to the exact product configuration.
